items.source_text: MyClaw 3.0 Build an always-on AI team with shared memory MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. items.title: Granular.Build
items.source_text: Granular.Build Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result. items.title: Airbot
items.source_text: Airbot The AI chief of staff that texts you first Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications. Productivity Sales Artificial Intelligence
